content.title: Douaouda Social Housing Development — 300 Homes
summary: The first phase of a 500-home social housing programme on the Douaouda coast, delivering 300 apartments across R+8 residential blocks with integrated ground-floor commercial premises.
SARL Igloo Yapi undertook the complete all-trades package: structural works, internal finishes, building services coordination, facade works, and site-wide infrastructure.
description: The R+8 blocks are arranged around F3 and F4 apartment layouts. Ground-floor commercial units create an active street frontage, integrating everyday retail and professional services directly into the residential fabric.

Completed in 2019, the project was delivered as a fully integrated handover package — from structural frame to facade finishes, and from building services installations to site road and utility connections.
content.authority: A complete social housing delivery combining reinforced concrete structure, building services coordination, and site infrastructure under a single all-trades contract.

faq.question: What is the Douaouda Social Housing Development?
faq.answer: The first phase of a 500-home social housing programme in Douaouda, delivering 300 apartments in R+8 residential blocks with F3 and F4 layouts and integrated ground-floor commercial units. Completed in 2019 for AADL.

faq.question: What construction services were delivered on this project?
faq.answer: The project was executed under an all-trades contract, covering reinforced concrete structure, secondary trades, building services, and site roads and utility networks.

faq.question: Who is the client for this housing programme?
faq.answer: The project was delivered for AADL, the Algerian national agency for social housing development.

faq.question: How are the residential blocks configured?
faq.answer: Each R+8 block accommodates F3 and F4 apartment layouts across the upper floors. Ground-floor levels are dedicated to commercial and professional premises, creating active street-level frontage across the development.
